answer: The wander counter is kept in spiral and sonnet publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Someone thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3590 identities would post 1367 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
